caption: Aa-kerk, Groningen
composition: Medieval brick church and baroque tower across the canal · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The Aa-kerk stands on the Akerkhof beside the canal. The church is medieval brick. The tower crown is the baroque lantern and closed spire, not the open Gothic crown of the Martinitoren, which is outside this frame. It is overcast, about 12.4°C, with wind near 5.8 km/h and cloud cover about 89%. The church is closed at this hour.
